budget_evidence: FODE paper comparison protocol: maximum FES=24,000 for every compared algorithm
FODE convergence figures use a common 200-iteration axis
Archived AGA and AGPSO drivers use population 50 and 200 iterations; the executable probe measured 10,000 and 20,050 physical FES, respectively
An algorithm's own publication budget is provenance context, not an override of the FODE comparison budget

budget_protocol.historical_literal: Use each archived/paper-derived algorithm's stated population and 200-generation/source stop rule; measure rather than assume physical FES.
budget_protocol.standardized_fixed_fes: Preserve operators and parameters but continue/cap every algorithm at exactly 24,000 physical evaluations.
budget_protocol.pooling_rule: Historical-literal and standardized-fixed-FES results are separate experiment families.
budget_protocol.terminal_partial_generation_rule: Retain every successfully evaluated candidate, update the best state, and stop before unused operators or unevaluated population phases.
budget_protocol.aga_standardized_continuation: Continue the archived generation operator sequence beyond generation 200 until the exact physical-FES cap.
budget_protocol.agpso_standardized_continuation: Continue the archived iteration sequence beyond iteration 200; if the cap occurs in the offspring phase, incorporate evaluated offspring into pBest and gBest before stopping.

priority: explicit parameter, equation, pseudocode or stage in the corresponding original paper
archived MATLAB experiment driver and active algorithm source for paper-omitted details
parameter_policy.unknown_value_rule: A genuinely undocumented value must use an explicit, justified reconstruction selected before formal results; it remains separately labelled in every artifact.
parameter_policy.conflict_rule: Record paper and source values separately; the formal native C++ method uses the paper-defined identity, while source-only differences remain diagnostic provenance.

smoke.purpose: Exercise initialization and at least one post-initialization transition for every algorithm and every FODE-E0-L case.
